definitions.explanation: A container for carrying drinking water or other beverages, typically portable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水筒|すいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: I'm bringing a water bottle on the field trip.

examples.japanese: {水筒|すいとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{麦茶|むぎちゃ}→麦茶：16494_mugicha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put barley tea in the water bottle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保温|ほおん}→保温：17467_hoon⟧{水筒|すいとう}⟦なら→なら：09575_nara⟧、⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|さ}め→冷める：02114_sameru⟧⟦にくい→〜にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: With an insulated bottle, drinks don't cool down easily.
examples.notes: 保温水筒 = thermos, insulated water bottle

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水筒|すいとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: On hot days, I put cold water in my water bottle and go out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧{水筒|すいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{洗|あら}って→洗う：00827_arau⟧、⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦あげている→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Every morning, I wash the water bottle my child takes to school and fill it with tea.

notes:
{水筒|すいとう} is the standard word for a reusable portable drinking container. The kanji literally mean 'water' ({水|すい}) + 'cylinder' ({筒|とう}). In Japan, bringing a {水筒|すいとう} is standard for school, work, and outings.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水筒|すいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ (to bring a water bottle)
- {水筒|すいとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to put something in a water bottle)
- {水筒|すいとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ (to wash a water bottle)

TYPES:
- ⟦{保温|ほおん}→保温：17467_hoon⟧{水筒|すいとう}: thermos, insulated bottle
- {保冷|ほれい}{水筒|すいとう}: cold-keeping water bottle
- マイ{水筒|すいとう}: one's own personal bottle (eco-conscious trend)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{魔法瓶|まほうびん}→魔法瓶：17387_mahoubin⟧: thermos (literally 'magic bottle')
- ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧: plastic bottle (disposable)
- タンブラー: tumbler (often with lid)
